description: This file defines a Babel plugin for transforming JSX and import statements within the Playwright testing framework, specifically for debugging purposes. It collects JSX component usages, manages import references, and modifies the AST accordingly.

methods.name: collectJsxComponentUsages
methods.description: Traverses a node to collect all JSX component names used within it.

methods.name: importInfo
methods.description: Generates an ImportInfo object containing metadata about an import specifier.
